title: South Delhi: Wife kills man with help from lover, tries to pass it off as robbery

However, police uncovered a dark plot involving the man's wife and her lover, who conspired to kill him. They sedated him, used electrocution, and artfully manipulated the scene to resemble a robbery.

title: Months after Dells’ $6.25bn ‘gift’, US Treasury sets new Trump Account paycheck rules
content: New rules from the US Treasury and IRS will allow payroll contributions to Trump Accounts. Employers can contribute up to $2,500 tax-free annually for employees' dependent children. Employees will also have the option to make pre-tax paycheck contributions directly into these accounts. Michael and Susan Dell pledged $6.25 billion to fund this child savings initiative. The proposed regulations are now open for public comment before finalization.

title: Ex-Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer changes how his $8 billion philanthropy works
content: Steve and Connie Ballmer are redefining their charitable strategy. The Ballmer Group is set to detach three regional branches, allowing them to operate as independent nonprofits. This adaptation is designed to align funding strategies more closely with the needs of local communities. With over eight billion dollars donated to charity, the Ballmers will shift their emphasis toward national-level initiatives focusing on economic mobility.

title: 'Very, very difficult': Can Kuldeep Yadav become India's next spin leader?
content: Kuldeep Yadav has played 18 Tests for India and taken 79 wickets in 34 innings. He has a bowling average of 22.35, an economy rate of 3.53 and a strike rate of 37.9. He has taken four four-wicket hauls and five five-wicket hauls. His best innings figures are 5/40, while his best match figures are 8/113. Kuldeep has also been a successful limited-overs bowler. He has 194 wickets from 121 ODIs at an average of 27.04. In 54 T20Is, he has taken 95 wickets at an average of 13.74.

title: $13.5M Maryland project turns dredged sand into 70 acres of wetland for marsh birds
content: In an impressive $13.5 million initiative, 70 acres of tidal wetland habitat have been established. By reusing dredged river sediment, a previously eroding marsh area was restored, benefiting local wildlife and commercial shipping activities alike. The introduction of native salt marsh grasses has fortified this new terrain, enhancing its stability. As a result, Maryland's shoreline and diverse wildlife now enjoy enhanced protection and habitat restoration.

title: Louisiana restores 1,170 acres in Barataria Basin; shrimp and crabs return after a year
content: Louisiana’s Upper Barataria Marsh Creation Project has restored 1,170 acres of new wetland habitat in the Barataria Basin. One year after construction, white and brown shrimp, blue crab and red drum are using the restored marsh and water features. The project aims to rebuild coastal ecosystems damaged by decades of land loss and the Deepwater Horizon oil spill.

title: Oracle layoffs: Company's '6 am layoff emails' may return in next few days
content: Oracle is preparing another round of layoffs this month, with cuts reaching double-digit percentages on some teams and managers already asked to name affected employees. The company wants payroll reduced before its second quarter starts on September 1. Oracle has already shed 21,000 jobs in a year, down to 141,000 staff, as it funds a debt-heavy AI data centre buildout that burned $23.7 billion in cash last fiscal year.

title: Jana Nayagan BO Day 21: Vijay film holds at Rs 65L, net reaches Rs 194.35 cr

Its overall India net collection has now reached Rs 194.35 crore. Worldwide gross collections for the film stand at Rs 319.57 crore. The H Vinoth directorial continues to perform well in its third week.

title: Kim Pegula makes emotional return to Bills stadium after cardiac arrest

Pegula, who suffered cardiac arrest and a brain injury in 2022, walked onto the field with husband Terry and son Matthew. Her return was especially meaningful because she helped plan the $2.2 billion stadium before her health crisis. The emotional appearance marked a significant moment for her family and the Bills.

title: How Brittany Mahomes manages a $325M franchise, fitness brand and 3 kids

She is recognized as an influential figure in American sports.

title: Why India wants 114 more Rafales and what gives the fighter its edge
content: Dassault Aviation from France has presented its proposal for acquiring 114 Rafale jets, aimed at strengthening India’s fighter fleet and addressing existing capability shortcomings. This initiative prioritizes significant local production and the transfer of technology to India. With a unified force of 176 Rafale aircraft, both the Indian Air Force and Navy will collaborate, enhancing India's domestic aerospace manufacturing and supporting indigenous defense projects.

title: 'Write Vishwavidyalaya in Hindi': UP minister's challenge to Rahul Gandhi
